cta.headline: Submit Your Abstract
cta.subheadline: Authors are invited to submit abstracts for oral, poster, or video presentations at the 5ᵗʰ International Conference on Organic and Natural Rice Production Systems.

hero.headline: Abstract Submission
hero.description: ORP-5 invites abstracts from academicians, researchers, students, and other stakeholders associated with organic and natural rice production systems. All submissions will undergo a blind peer-review process and be considered for oral, poster, or video presentation, as per the conference guidelines.
hero.subheadline: The 5ᵗʰ International Conference on Organic and Natural Rice Production Systems invites abstracts for oral, poster, and video presentations.

review.title: Review & Acceptance
review.description: All submitted abstracts will be reviewed by the conference committee through a blind peer-review process. Based on their overall quality, impact, and relevance to the conference themes, abstracts will be accepted for oral, poster, or video presentation. The decision of the conference committee will be final.

support.title: Help & Support
support.description: For queries related to abstract submission, authors may contact the conference secretariat at editor@orp5ic.com .

categories.title: Oral Presentations
categories.description: Abstracts accepted for oral presentation will be presented during the technical sessions of ORP-5, as decided by the conference committee.

categories.title: Poster Presentations
categories.description: Abstracts accepted for poster presentation will be displayed during the designated poster sessions of the conference.

categories.title: Video Presentations
categories.description: Abstracts accepted for video presentation will be presented in video format during the technical sessions, as per conference guidelines.

hero.headline: AIASA National Awards 2026
hero.subheadline: 5th International Conference on Organic & Natural Rice Production Systems (ORP-5)

intro.title: Awards & Prizes
intro.description: The Governing Board of AIASA annually confers National Awards to persons/institutions for their outstanding contribution on empowerment of youth in Agriculture. Adopting rigorous screening at state/zonal and central levels, all awards carry a Citation and a Memento. The nominee can receive awards up to 2 times within 5 years.

judging.title: Selection Process
judging.description: The awards will be conferred by adopting rigorous screening at each stage in States/zones and at the Central level on an all-India nomination basis.

criteria.title: Application Rules
criteria.description: Individual/institution needs to submit only one application for any award irrespective of year. Multiple applications shall be outrightly rejected.

criteria.title: Frequency Limits
criteria.description: Among AIASA members, nominees can receive awards up to 2 times within 5 years. Eligible again only after a 5-year gap.

criteria.title: Format & Deadline
criteria.description: Recommendations/nominations must be sent in the prescribed format latest by 15th August 2026.

categories.title: Outstanding Leadership in Agriculture
categories.description: For individuals who made a positive impact on the well-being of stakeholders in agriculture and given a definite direction for the betterment of the sector.

categories.title: Lifetime Achievement Award
categories.description: For unique and special contributions over a prolonged period to the farming community and advancement of agriculture through production, innovation, leadership, or advocacy.

categories.title: Best Vice-Chancellor Award
categories.description: Conferred to energetic Honorable Vice Chancellors for outstanding contributions at colleges and research stations, creating exceptional academic pedagogy.

categories.title: Dr. M.S. Swaminathan Award (Master Research)
categories.description: Outstanding Master Research in Agricultural & Allied Sciences including Crop/Horticulture, NRM, Animal/Fisheries, and Social Sciences.

categories.title: Dr. M.S. Swaminathan Award (Doctoral Research)
categories.description: Outstanding Doctoral Research in Agricultural & Allied Sciences including Crop/Horticulture, NRM, Animal/Fisheries, and Social Sciences.

categories.title: Harit Ratna Awards
categories.description: For outstanding empowerment of youth in agriculture at the level of Dean, Director, Vice-Chancellor, or CEO.

categories.title: Krishi Jeevan Jyoti Award
categories.description: Exclusively for AIASA members for their outstanding contribution towards the empowerment of youth and social mobilization.

categories.title: Pragati Puraskar (Best Farmer Award)
categories.description: For the best progressive farmers adapting and disseminating improved technology and practices for increased income and sustainability.

categories.title: Student of the Year Award
categories.description: For outstanding contributions toward the empowerment of youth and social activities for the betterment of the agricultural fraternity.

categories.title: AIASA Gold Medal
categories.description: Conferred to AIASA members, Associate members, officers, and individuals working in Govt, NGOs, or Private sectors.

categories.title: Best Teacher Award
categories.description: For a student-friendly faculty member with substantial experience in teaching and research in agriculture and allied sectors.

categories.title: Young Scientist Award
categories.description: For outstanding research work and publications in National/International journals in the field of agriculture and allied sectors.

categories.title: Harit Kranti Award
categories.description: For agriculture activists from private or public sectors mobilizing progressive farmers and raising the voice of farmers.

categories.title: Harit Puraskar Award
categories.description: For a renowned agriculturist for outstanding contribution to best agricultural practices in govt departments, universities, public sectors, and NGOs.

categories.title: Institution of Excellence Award
categories.description: Recognizes outstanding performance in developing infrastructure, research output, and extension services in agriculture.
